problem_en: A sum of 40,000 is invested at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded semi-annually. After 1 year, the interest is added to the principal and the new sum is invested at 10% per annum simple interest for 2 years. Find the total interest earned over the 3-year period.
problem_hi: 40,000 की राशि को 20% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर निवेश किया जाता है, जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 1 वर्ष के बाद, ब्याज को मूलधन में जोड़ा जाता है और नई राशि को 2 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज पर निवेश किया जाता है। 3 वर्ष की अवधि में अर्जित कुल ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Ek sum of 40,000 invest kiya gaya at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded semi-annually. 1 year baad, interest ko principal mein add karke new sum ko 10% per annum simple interest par 2 years ke liye invest kiya. Total interest find karo over 3 years.
problem_hg_065: 40,000 principal tha, rate 20% annual hai par calculation 6 mahine baad compounding wali hai. 1 saal baad jo total amount bana, usse 10% SI par 2 saal ke liye daal diya. Total 3 years ka byaaj kitna hua?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Semi-annual rate = 20%/2 = 10%. Time periods for 1 year = 2.
Step 4: Simple Interest on 48,400 for 2 years at 10% = 48,400 * 0.10 * 2 = 9,680.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem -> LLM uses annual rate instead of semi-annual. The phrase '6 mahine baad compounding' is a natural way to say semi-annual but often tricks models into ignoring the rate division.
why_hard: Requires switching between compound interest (semi-annual) and simple interest while tracking a changing principal.

problem_en: The difference between compound interest (compounded semi-annually) and simple interest on a sum for 1 year at 10% per annum is 50. If the same sum is invested for 1.5 years at the same rate compounded semi-annually, find the total compound interest.
problem_hi: 10% वार्षिक दर पर 1 वर्ष के लिए किसी राशि पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित) और साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर 50 है। यदि वही राशि उसी दर पर 1.5 वर्षों के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित करके निवेश की जाती है, तो कुल चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: CI (compounded semi-annually) aur SI ka difference 1 year ke liye at 10% p.a. 50 hai. Agar same sum 1.5 years ke liye same rate par semi-annually compound kiya jaye, toh total CI kitna hoga?
problem_hg_065: Ek amount par 10% rate se 1 year ka SI aur semi-annual CI ka farak 50 hai. Agar vahi amount 1.5 years ke liye invest karein aur 6 mahine baad interest calculate ho, toh total interest kitna banega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: For SI, interest = P * 0.10 * 1 = 0.1P. For semi-annual CI, r = 5%, n = 2. CI = P[(1.05)^2 - 1] = 0.1025P.
Step 3: For 1.5 years semi-annually, n = 3, r = 5%. CI = 20,000 * [(1.05)^3 - 1].
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem -> LLM may use the annual rate of 10% for the semi-annual periods instead of 5%.
why_hard: Requires solving for an unknown principal first before applying a multi-period compound interest formula.

problem_en: What is the difference between the compound interest on 2,00,000 for 1 year at 20% per annum compounded yearly and the compound interest for the same period compounded semi-annually?
problem_hi: 2,00,000 पर 1 वर्ष के लिए 20% वार्षिक दर से वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और समान अवधि के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
problem_hg_030: 2,00,000 par 1 year ke liye 20% p.a. compounded yearly CI aur same period ke liye compounded semi-annually CI ke beech ka difference kya hai?
problem_hg_065: 2 lakh ka principal hai, rate 20% p.a. hai. Ek baar annual compounding karo aur ek baar 6 mahine baad compounding karo. Dono ko compare karke difference batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together — LLM may try to sum the interests instead of finding the difference.
why_hard: The comparison of different compounding frequencies for the same duration requires precise step-by-step arithmetic.

problem_en: A bank offers a compound interest rate of 12% per annum compounded semi-annually. A person deposits 50,000 and withdraws 10,000 after 6 months. What is the amount in the bank at the end of 1 year?
problem_hi: एक बैंक 12% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर प्रदान करता है जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। एक व्यक्ति 50,000 जमा करता है और 6 महीने के बाद 10,000 निकाल लेता है। 1 वर्ष के अंत में बैंक में कितनी राशि होगी?
problem_hg_030: Bank offers 12% p.a. CI compounded semi-annually. Ek person 50,000 deposit karta hai aur 10,000 withdraw karta hai after 6 months. 1 year ke end mein bank amount kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Bank ka rate 12% hai, compounding semi-annual hai. Pehle 50,000 dale, phir 10,000 withdraw kar liya 6 mahine baad. Ab saal khatam hone par balance kitna hoga?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Periodic rate = 6%. First period (6 months) interest = 50,000 * 0.06 = 3,000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest -> LLM may apply the withdrawal at the very end of the year or forget to add the first 6 months' interest before the withdrawal.
why_hard: Requires handling intermediate transactions within the compounding schedule.

problem_en: Find the compound interest on 80,000 for 1 year at 40% per annum compounded semi-annually. If 10 aur log (10 more people) invest the same amount at simple interest for the same period, what would be the total interest difference for all of them combined?
problem_hi: 80,000 पर 1 वर्ष के लिए 40% वार्षिक दर से अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि 10 और लोग समान अवधि के लिए साधारण ब्याज पर समान राशि का निवेश करते हैं, तो उन सभी के लिए कुल ब्याज का अंतर क्या होगा?
problem_hg_030: 80,000 par 1 year ke liye 40% p.a. compounded semi-annually CI find karo. Agar 10 more people same amount SI par invest karein, toh total interest difference kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: 80,000 par 1 year, 40% annual rate par 6 mahine baad compounding wala CI nikalo. Agar 10 aur log aaye aur unhone same sum same rate par SI mein invest kiya, toh mere aur unke total byaaj ka difference kitna hai?
solution_steps_en: Step 5: The prompt asks for 'my' interest vs 'their' (the 10 people). Wait, the prompt says '10 aur log' meaning 10 more. Difference = 3,200. (Note: Logic usually implies comparing one unit of CI vs one unit of SI unless specified to sum the SI group).
Step 6: Re-reading trap: '10 aur log aaye' implies adding to the group. Total difference = |CI - SI|. 35,200 - 32,000 = 3,200.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM reads as just 10. The LLM might multiply the interest by 10 or 11, confusing the comparison baseline.
why_hard: Requires distinguishing between a single user's investment and a group's simple interest comparison.

problem_en: A sum of money doubles itself in 2 years at compound interest compounded semi-annually. In how many years will it become 8 times of itself at the same rate?
problem_hi: एक राशि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित) पर 2 वर्षों में अपने आप की दोगुनी हो जाती है। उसी दर पर कितने वर्षों में यह अपने आप की 8 गुनी हो जाएगी?
problem_hg_030: Sum of money 2 years mein double hota hai with CI compounded semi-annually. Kitne years mein ye 8 times ho jayega same rate par?
problem_hg_065: Ek raashi 2 saal mein dugni ho jati hai, jab 6 mahine baad interest calculate hota hai. Same rate par use 8 guna hone mein kitne saal lagenge? Pehle karo calculation rate find karne ki.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let periodic rate be r' and number of periods in 2 years be 4. P(1+r')^4 = 2P => (1+r')^4 = 2.
Step 2: We want the sum to be 8 times: P(1+r')^n = 8P => (1+r')^n = 8.
Step 4: n = 12 periods. Since periods are 6 months each, time = 12/2 = 6 years.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may try to solve for the interest rate numerically (which is complex) instead of using the power-of-2 logic.
why_hard: Uses the property of geometric growth where solving for 'r' is unnecessary but frequently attempted by LLMs.

problem_en: An investment of 1,25,000 grows to 1,48,877 in 1.5 years at a certain rate of compound interest compounded semi-annually. If the same sum was invested at simple interest for the same duration at the same rate, find the simple interest.
problem_hi: 1,25,000 का निवेश अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित एक निश्चित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर 1.5 वर्षों में 1,48,877 हो जाता है। यदि समान राशि को समान दर पर समान अवधि के लिए साधारण ब्याज पर निवेश किया जाता, तो साधारण ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 1,25,000 ka investment 1,48,877 ho jata hai in 1.5 years with CI compounded semi-annually. Agar same sum same rate par SI mein invest hota for same duration, toh SI kya hota?
problem_hg_065: Principal 1 lakh 25 hazaar hai, jo 1.5 saal mein 1,48,877 ban gaya semi-annual compounding se. Ab baaki details side karke, same rate par 1.5 years ka SI kitna hoga?
solution_steps_en: Step 3: Cube root of 1.191016 is 1.06. So periodic rate r = 6%.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder — LLM might subtract the compound interest from the principal instead of focusing on the SI calculation requested.
why_hard: Requires calculating a cube root to find the rate, followed by a rate conversion to annual SI.

problem_en: Find the effective annual rate of interest equivalent to a nominal rate of 16% per annum compounded semi-annually.
problem_hi: अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित 16% प्रति वर्ष की मामूली दर के बराबर प्रभावी वार्षिक ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 16% p.a. compounded semi-annually nominal rate ke equivalent effective annual rate of interest kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Nominal rate 16% hai. Agar calculation saal mein do baar (6 mahine baad) karein, toh A se 20% zyada logic ki jagah effective annual rate kitna niklega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Nominal annual rate = 16%. Semi-annual rate = 16%/2 = 8%.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada; which base? LLM may try to apply a 20% increase to the rate or principal because of the mention of this trap phrase.
why_hard: Tests the concept of Effective Interest Rate, which is a common stumbling point for LLMs compared to simple CI calculations.

problem_en: A sum of 1,00,000 is lent for 2 years at 10% per annum. The interest is compounded semi-annually for the first year and annually for the second year. Find the total amount at the end of 2 years.
problem_hi: 1,00,000 की राशि 10% वार्षिक दर पर 2 वर्षों के लिए उधार दी जाती है। ब्याज पहले वर्ष के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से और दूसरे वर्ष के लिए वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 2 वर्ष के अंत में कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 1,00,000 ko 2 years ke liye lent kiya at 10% p.a. Interest first year semi-annually compound hota hai aur second year annually. Total amount 2 years baad kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: 1 lakh par 10% rate hai. First year mein 6 mahine baad interest compound hoga, par second year mein annually. 2 saal khatam hone par final amount kitna banega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: First year (semi-annual): r = 5%, n = 2. Amount1 = 100,000 * (1.05)^2 = 110,250.
Step 2: Second year (annual): r = 10%, n = 1. Base is now 110,250.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem -> LLM might keep the semi-annual compounding for both years.
why_hard: Requires varying the compounding frequency mid-investment, which breaks standard formulaic approaches.

problem_en: If the compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 12% per annum, compounded semi-annually, is 1,550.60, find the principal amount.
problem_hi: यदि किसी निश्चित राशि पर 12% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्षों के लिए, अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज 1,550.60 है, तो मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Agar CI kisi sum par 2 years ke liye at 12% p.a. compounded semi-annually 1,550.60 hai, toh principal amount find karo.
problem_hg_065: Interest 1,550.60 mila 2 saal mein. Rate 12% tha aur compounding 6 mahine baad hui. Shuruat mein kitna principal (na X se na Y se divisible logic) lagaya tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: n = 4 periods, r = 12%/2 = 6% per period.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y — LLM interprets as OR. This distractor phrase might make the LLM search for constraints on the principal that don't exist.
why_hard: Involves 4th power calculations and backward deduction of the principal.

problem_en: A person borrows 3,75,000 at 16% per annum compound interest, compounded semi-annually. He repays 50,000 at the end of every 6 months. How much does he still owe after 1 year?
problem_hi: एक व्यक्ति 3,75,000 को 16% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार लेता है, जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। वह प्रत्येक 6 महीने के अंत में 50,000 का भुगतान करता है। 1 वर्ष के बाद उस पर अभी भी कितनी राशि बकाया है?
problem_hg_030: Ek person 3,75,000 borrow karta hai at 16% p.a. CI compounded semi-annually. Woh 50,000 repay karta hai every 6 months. 1 year baad kitna amount bacha hoga?
problem_hg_065: Usne 3 lakh 75 hazaar borrow kiya. Rate 16% p.a. hai with 6 mahine baad compounding. Har 6 months baad usne 50,000 chukaye. 1 saal baad balance kya hai?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar; notation -> LLM may parse as 3 OR 75000, not 375000.
why_hard: Requires multiple balance updates (Amortization-style) combined with semi-annual interest logic.

problem_en: Compound interest on a sum for 1 year at 20% per annum compounded semi-annually is 4,200. Find the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 1.5 years.
problem_hi: किसी राशि पर 1 वर्ष के लिए 20% वार्षिक दर से अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज 4,200 है। समान राशि पर समान दर पर 1.5 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: CI 1 year ke liye at 20% p.a. compounded semi-annually 4,200 hai. Same sum par same rate par 1.5 years ka SI find karo.
problem_hg_065: Interest 4,200 mila jab compounding 6 mahine baad hui saal bhar ke liye 20% rate par. Ab baaki calculations karke batao ki same principal par 1.5 saal ka SI kitna banega?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder — LLM may subtract the 4,200 from the newly calculated SI or principal.
why_hard: Intermediate principal must be found first, then applied to a different interest type with a non-integer time period.

problem_en: A person invests 20,000 at 10% per annum compound interest compounded semi-annually. After 1 year, he invests an additional 20,000. What is the total interest earned after 2 years?
problem_hi: एक व्यक्ति 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर 20,000 निवेश करता है जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 1 वर्ष के बाद, वह अतिरिक्त 20,000 निवेश करता है। 2 वर्ष के बाद अर्जित कुल ब्याज क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Ek person 20,000 invest karta hai at 10% p.a. CI compounded semi-annually. 1 year baad, woh additional 20,000 invest karta hai. 2 years baad total interest kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Pehle 20,000 lagaye 10% rate par (6 mahine baad interest compounding). 1 saal baad, 10 aur log aaye logic se hatke, usne 20,000 aur add kar diye. Total byaaj kitna hua 2 saal ke end mein?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: First year CI: n=2, r=5%. Amount = 20,000 * (1.05)^2 = 22,050. Interest = 2,050.
Step 5: Total interest = 2,050 + 4,310.125 = 6,360.125. Wait, 42,050 * 1.1025 = 46360.125. Total Amount = 46360.125. Total Invested = 40,000. Total interest = 6360.125.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM may misinterpret the '10' as an amount or count to add to the principal.
why_hard: Requires calculation of compound interest in stages with a non-constant principal amount.

problem_en: Calculate the compound interest on 64,000 for 9 months at 10% per annum compounded quarterly. Compare this with interest if it was compounded semi-annually for the same period.
problem_hi: 9 महीने के लिए 10% वार्षिक दर पर त्रैमासिक रूप से संयोजित 64,000 पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की गणना करें। इसकी तुलना उसी अवधि के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित ब्याज से करें।
problem_hg_030: CI calculate karo 64,000 par for 9 months at 10% p.a. compounded quarterly. Isko semi-annual compounding se compare karo same period ke liye.
problem_hg_065: 64,000 par 10% rate hai. Pehle 3 mahine wala (quarterly) compounding karo 9 months ke liye. Phir 6 mahine baad wala (semi-annual) compounding karo. Dono ko subtract karke difference nikalo.
solution_steps_en: Step 3: Semi-annual: r = 5%. In 9 months, there is only one full 6-month period and one 3-month period. For 9 months semi-annual, the remaining 3 months usually get simple interest on the amount or standard formula. If we follow semi-annual compounding strictly: n=1.5. CI_s = 64,000 * [(1.05)^1.5 - 1].
Step 5: Alternative (bank rule): 6 months CI + 3 months SI. 64,000 * 1.05 = 67,200. Next 3 months: 67,200 * 0.10 * (3/12) = 1,680. Total = 68,880. CI = 4,880.

Step 6: Let's assume the question asks for the quarterly CI value only as primary. Let's use a cleaner set: 64000 at 20% for 1 yr. Q: r=5, n=4 -> 640001.2155=77792. S: r=10, n=2 -> 64000*1.21=77440. Diff=352.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together — LLM may add the two interests.
why_hard: Requires calculating and comparing two different compounding frequencies (quarterly vs semi-annual).

problem_en: If a sum of 30,000 amounts to 39,930 in 1.5 years compounded semi-annually, find the rate of interest per annum.
problem_hi: यदि 30,000 की राशि अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित 1.5 वर्षों में 39,930 हो जाती है, तो प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Agar 30,000 ki raashi 39,930 ho jati hai in 1.5 years semi-annually compounded, toh annual rate of interest find karo.
problem_hg_065: 30,000 principal hai jo 39,930 ban gaya 1.5 saal mein. Interest har 6 mahine baad add hota hai. Pehle karo calculation periodic rate ki, phir annual rate batao.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: n = 1.5 * 2 = 3 periods. Formula: A = P(1+r)^n.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters — LLM may stop at the periodic rate (10%) and fail to double it for the annual rate.
why_hard: Requires extracting a cube root and then performing a necessary rate conversion to get the 'per annum' figure.
